name: sbb-lost-found
description: Enterprise-grade lost and found system for SBB Swiss public transport

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sbb-lost-found/reporting-service run test && pnpm --dir frontend run test
scripts.lint: pnpm -r run lint && pnpm --dir frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend run typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm --filter @sbb-lost-found/types run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:tenant
